open_items: ERDDAP robots.txt. Both NOAA ERDDAP servers tell crawlers not to fetch query URLs. ERDDAP itself is NOAA's data API, and its documentation says every form has a matching service "designed to be easy for computer programs and scripts to use". HarborLedger made four targeted, cached requests, not a crawl. This is recorded as a judgement call, not a settled permission. If it matters (for example before any commercial use), email the ERDDAP administrators (erd.data@noaa.gov) and record the answer here.

OEHHA / CalEPA terms. The SB 535 layer's own terms could not be read because the OEHHA site requires a CAPTCHA, which this project will not get past. Read https://oehha.ca.gov/public-information/conditions-use in a browser, or email OEHHA, and record the result here. Only derived hour shares are published, not the polygons.
PSIX. No explicit licence exists. The Coast Guard offers the bulk web service publicly and the data is a FOIA snapshot, so it is treated as a federal work.
